items.name: c-file-type-1
items.title: Common formats
items.description: The formats people share most, in their brand colors.
items.descriptionLong: Common formats. Built with the File Type component. A free, open source shadcn file type example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-file-type-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-file-type-6

Uses @tanstack/react-table alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn file type example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-file-type-6 and edit as your own code.
